title: HR300S-5T1XS
brief: The HR300S-5T1XS is a compact yet powerful Ethernet switch designed to deliver high-speed connectivity and reliable performance for small to medium-sized networks. With 5x 2.5Gbps RJ45 ports and 1x 10Gbps SFP+ port, this switch is ideal for environments requiring fast data transfer, such as home offices, small businesses, and creative studios. Its advanced features, including auto-negotiation, flow control, and intuitive status monitoring, ensure seamless operation and easy troubleshooting.
